The '''Tumani system''' was located in the [[Interior Region]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Ediorung system/Legends|Ediorung]] and [[Tinta system/Legends|Tinta systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Tumani [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of the [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]] known as [[Tumanian pressure-ruby|Tumanian pressure-rubies]].<ref name="SotE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Tumanian pressure-ruby]]|system=Tumani [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tumani system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
